title: Vertex energies of splitting and shadow graphs
summary: Graph energy has been widely investigated in spectral graph theory. However, the manner in which this energy is distributed among individual vertices has received attention only more recently, following the introduction of energy of a vertex by O. Arizmendi et al. in 2018. Since then, several studies have explored this concept. In the present work, we focus on splitting graphs and shadow graphs and study how the total energy of a graph is distributed among its vertices.
